notes.title: Friday Update!
notes.notes:
Hello guys,

This is the last update before the release at it's mainly a bug fix update!

Issues fixed :

- The avatar now move with platforms
- The avatar don't get stuck anymore on the level 4 in certain cases
- Several sound fx where missing in somes levels of the W3, not anymore
- Several Animation issues fixed

Improvement
- Level where you can stop the time the end of the level has been improved
- New Tutorial added on the first level.

"Feature"
- Credits added when you finish the game

notes.title: Mac version and Level Menu!
notes.notes:
This week we give you a new update with improvements and new features

Dear community,

Here is the weekly changelist (sorry we are a bit late!):

Major Improvements
- Mac version is now available
- Level menu is now available

Bug fix:
- Fixed a bug where the "mirror" player could collect an orb
- Fixed several enemies that did not kill the avatar when they should

Other Improvement:
- Last level as been improved
- Leve "I want to go..." as been improved
- Level "Help" as been improved
- Minor change on the level "I saved him from his dark thought"
- New avatar's animation on the special "tribute level"

TL;DR: Less bugs, mac support, and level selection!

What we are working on Now:

- We improve the bonus world you will get if you can find all the masks.
- We are Finishing the ending
- We work on the keybinding menu
- Several graphics need to be improved as well.
- New musics!
- We also work on bug fix and level improvement as usual.

Thanks.

notes.title: ecotone: First patch
notes.notes:
Dear community,

The first update of ecotone is online and contains a few things: 

BUG FIX

- Pause menu not showing: FIXED
- Avatar with no gravity : FIXED
- Shader missing or misplaced: FIXED

Other improvements

- Several levels has been improved (bug fix, better flow etc...)
- Several levels are now easier
- New Jellyfish's controls
- Ambiance sound has been added
- New sound for firefly (will be improved)

We are now working on others bugs, and improvements, and we plan to release a new build each week!

TL;DR: Less bugs, More fun!

Thank you!
